headword: {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}

definitions.explanation: A person who works compulsively and excessively, or the state of being addicted to work. A calque of the English word 'workaholic.'

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}だ。
{仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}で{家族|かぞく}との{時間|じかん}がない。
examples.english: Being a workaholic, I have no time with my family.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}になりやすい{人|ひと}は、{休日|きゅうじつ}でも{仕事|しごと}のことを{考|かんが}えてしまうそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently, people who tend to become workaholics can't stop thinking about work even on their days off.

notes:
USAGE:
A Japanese translation of the English concept "workaholic," using {中毒|ちゅうどく} (addiction/poisoning). The loanword ワーカホリック is also used. Can describe both the person and the condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}になる (to become a workaholic)
- {仕事|しごと}{中毒|ちゅうどく}の{人|ひと} (a workaholic person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ワーカホリック: workaholic — loanword equivalent
- {過労|かろう}: overwork — focuses on the result rather than the compulsion
- {働|はたら}きすぎ: overworking — colloquial equivalent
